full_script: [serious] Has perdido algo y vas a la comisaría. Explícalo en inglés antes de que lo diga yo. Where's the police station? I've lost my wallet. It was black leather. Ahora, nivel intermedio. I left it in a taxi. My passport was in it. Will you let me know if it turns up? I'd like to report a theft. Y ahora, nivel experto. My phone was stolen. I didn't notice until I got to the hotel. I've been mugged. Si llegaste a la tres, básico. Si llegaste a la siete, intermedio. Y con las diez, experto: caso cerrado.
